Table: XLA_AADS_H

Description: The XLA_AADS_H table stores the history of the application accounting definitions. The history is updated when the application accounting definitions are exported.
Primary Key: XLA_AADS_H_PK
  1. APPLICATION_ID
  2. PRODUCT_RULE_TYPE_CODE
  3. PRODUCT_RULE_CODE
  4. VERSION_NUM
Comments
***** Warning: Oracle Internal Use Only *****

Oracle Corporation does not support access to Oracle applications data using this object, except from standard Oracle Applications programs.

Table: XLA_AAD_GROUPS

Description: The XLA_AAD_GROUPS table stores the merge dependencies analyzed during the merge analysis. All application accounting definitions with the same GROUP_NUM must be merged together.
Primary Key: XLA_AAD_GROUPS_PK
  1. AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
  2. APPLICATION_ID
  3. PRODUCT_RULE_TYPE_CODE
  4. PRODUCT_RULE_CODE

This column indicates which account is generated by the account derivation rule The possible values are :.ALL : The rule is used to generate both the gain and loss accountCredit : The rule is used to generate gain accountDebit : The rule is used to generate loss accountNA : The line is not a gain/loss line, the rule is used to generate the account used in that line

Table: XLA_TB_DEFN_DETAILS

Description: This table stores the Open Account Balances Listing report definition details
Comments

This table contains detail information about the Open Account Balances Listing report definitions. The information here specifies the GL account (CCID) or segment values that will be tracked for reporting by the Open Account Balances Listing report. The records in this table are child records
to the XLA_TB_DEFINITIONS_B table. There is one row in this table for every GL account or range of segment values defined in the Create Open Account Balances Listing Report Definition page.

CODE_COMBINATION_ID

Y Object version number

This column stores the name of the segment whose values will be tracked for reporting. If null, then the definition is defined by a CCID.

High value for the segment corresponding to the value in the FLEXFIELD_SEGMENT_CODE column.

The CCID that will be reported by this report definition. Must be null if XLA_TB_DEFINITIONS.DEFINED_BY_CODE is ''SEGMENT''.

This tables stores segment ranges generated based on Open Account Balances Listing report definition details. When the report definition is definied by Flexfield, the SEGMENT_FROM/TO
columns stores to segment values of given accounts. In this case, SEGMENT_FROM and SEGMENT_TO have the same value. When the report definition is defined by Segment, the SEGMENT_FROM/TO columns store values of XLA_TB_DEFN_DETAILS.SEGMENT_VALUE_FROM/TO.

This table serves as a work unit table to process open account balances data in parallel. Accounting entries are split into multiple units based on ledger setups. For any new record, the STATUS_CODE column is initialized to UNPROCESSED. (Disabled definitions remain UNPROCESSED until that definition is enabled).
